name: Social Web App
description: A social web app for sharing content, connecting, and real-time interaction.

current_prd.elevator_pitch: Our social web app empowers users to connect, share moments, and engage in real-time conversations. We solve the problem of fragmented online interactions by providing a seamless platform for content sharing, personalized feeds, and dynamic community building, fostering genuine connections and vibrant online communities.
current_prd.problem_statement: Users often experience fragmented online interactions across multiple platforms, lacking a single, cohesive space for real-time content sharing, personalized feeds, and dynamic community engagement.
current_prd.solution: The social web app provides a unified platform for users to sign up, create profiles, share diverse content (text, images), and engage in real-time interactions like liking and commenting. It offers personalized feeds based on follows, fostering community and seamless content discovery.

key_features.feature_description: Enable user signup/login via email and social authentication (e.g., Google, Facebook). Allow users to manage their profile, including bio, avatar, and account settings.
Users can create posts with text and images. They can also like and comment on other users' posts.
Users can follow and unfollow other users. The main feed will display a customized timeline of content from followed users.
Enable real-time updates for posting, commenting, and liking without page reloads. Implement infinite scroll for seamless content browsing.
A dedicated dashboard for administrators to moderate user-generated content, manage user accounts, and view key analytics on platform usage and performance.

steps: User navigates to the app's login/signup page.
User chooses to sign up with email or a social provider (Google, Facebook).
If email: User enters email and password, then confirms email (if required).
If social: User authenticates through the chosen social provider.
System creates/authenticates user account and redirects to the main feed.
User logs in and navigates to their profile page.
User clicks 'Edit Profile'.
User updates bio, changes avatar, or modifies account settings.
User clicks 'Save Changes'.
System updates user profile information and displays confirmation.
User is on the main feed or their profile page.
User clicks 'Create Post' button.
User enters text and/or uploads an image.
User clicks 'Post'.
System publishes the post, which appears in the user's feed and followers' timelines in real-time.
User views a post on their feed.
To like: User clicks the 'Like' icon.
System registers the like and updates the like count in real-time.
To comment: User clicks the 'Comment' icon.
User types their comment and presses 'Enter' or 'Post Comment'.
System publishes the comment, which appears under the post in real-time.
User views another user's profile.
To follow: User clicks the 'Follow' button.
System registers the follow relationship and updates the follower count.
To unfollow: User clicks the 'Following' button (which changes to 'Unfollow').
System removes the follow relationship and updates the follower count.
The user's personalized feed is updated to reflect the change in followed users.
Admin logs into the Admin Dashboard.
Admin navigates to the 'Content Moderation' section.
Admin reviews reported posts or flags suspicious content.
Admin can approve, reject, or delete content.
System updates content status and notifies the original poster if necessary.
Admin logs into the Admin Dashboard.
Admin navigates to the 'User Management' section.
Admin searches for specific users or browses the user list.
Admin can view user profiles, edit user roles, or suspend/delete accounts.
System applies changes to user accounts and logs the action.
Admin logs into the Admin Dashboard.
Admin navigates to the 'Analytics' section.
Admin views dashboards displaying user activity, content trends, and system performance metrics.
Admin can filter data by time range or other parameters.
System provides real-time or near real-time analytical insights.

current_prd.success_metrics: User engagement (daily active users, session duration, posts per user), content virality (likes, comments, shares per post), user retention rate, new user sign-ups, number of followed relationships, and admin moderation efficiency.
current_prd.competitors: Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, TikTok, Reddit, Mastodon, Bluesky.
current_prd.vision: To become a leading social platform that fosters authentic connections and vibrant communities through seamless real-time interaction and personalized content experiences, continuously evolving to meet user needs and adapt to emerging social trends.

target_audience.name: Socially Active Individuals
target_audience.pain_points: Fragmented social experiences across multiple apps, lack of real-time engagement, privacy concerns, overwhelming content feeds.
target_audience.demographics: Ages 18-35, tech-savvy, active on social media, diverse interests.
target_audience.needs_and_goals: Connect with friends and family, share personal updates and experiences, discover new content, engage in discussions, express creativity.

target_audience.name: Content Creators and Community Builders
target_audience.pain_points: Limited reach on existing platforms, difficulty in fostering genuine community interaction, complex analytics, lack of control over content distribution.
target_audience.demographics: Content creators, influencers, small businesses, community organizers.
target_audience.needs_and_goals: Reach a wider audience, build and engage a community, monetize content (future consideration), gain insights into audience engagement.

features: User Authentication and Profile Management (email signup/login, profile management: bio, avatar, account settings)
Content Creation and Interaction (create text posts, like and comment on posts)
Following and Personalized Feed (follow/unfollow, customized timeline from followed users)
phasing.rationale: This phase delivers the absolute core functionality of a social web app. Users can register, create a profile, share basic content, interact with others, and see a personalized feed. This is a functional and 'Launch-able' product for early adopters and a strong 'Demo-able' version for stakeholders.

features: User Authentication and Profile Management (add social authentication: Google, Facebook)
Content Creation and Interaction (add image support for posts)
Real-time Interactions and Infinite Scroll (real-time updates for posting, commenting, liking; infinite scroll for content browsing)
phasing.rationale: This phase significantly enhances the user experience by adding real-time capabilities and seamless content browsing (infinite scroll). It also expands content creation to include images and simplifies user onboarding with social authentication, making the platform more engaging and ready for a 'Beta Launch'.

features: Admin Dashboard (moderate user-generated content, manage user accounts, view key analytics)
phasing.rationale: This phase provides essential tools for platform administrators to maintain a healthy and secure environment. It enables content moderation, user management, and performance monitoring, which are critical for the long-term success and scalability of the social app. This phase makes the product 'Launch-able' to a wider audience with proper operational support.

current_prd.design_principles:
User-Centric Design: Prioritize ease of use, intuitive interactions, and a delightful user experience.
Real-time Responsiveness: Ensure immediate feedback for user actions like posting, liking, and commenting.
Accessibility: Design for all users, including those with disabilities, following WCAG guidelines.
Consistency: Maintain a unified visual language and interaction patterns across the entire application.
Performance: Optimize for speed and efficiency, especially with infinite scroll and real-time updates.
Scalability: Design with future growth in mind, allowing for easy addition of new features and increased user base.

user_personas.name: Active Socializer
user_personas.goals: Share daily experiences, connect with friends, discover new content, express opinions.
user_personas.pain_points: Cluttered feeds, slow loading times, lack of privacy controls, irrelevant content.

user_personas.name: Content Creator
user_personas.goals: Showcase their work, build an audience, get feedback, monetize content.
user_personas.pain_points: Limited reach, difficulty in content promotion, lack of engagement tools, copyright issues.

Displays a modal or dedicated screen for post creation.
Enters text, optionally uploads an image.
Clicks 'Post'.
Publishes the post and displays it in the user's feed and followers' timelines in real-time.

user_journeys.context: An Active Socializer wants to share a new update with their followers.

steps.description: Scrolls through their feed and finds an interesting post.
Clicks the 'Like' icon on the post.
Increments the like count and visually updates the 'Like' icon in real-time.

steps.description: Clicks on the 'Comment' icon or the comment section of a post.
Expands the comment section or opens a comment input field.
Types their comment and clicks 'Post Comment'.
Publishes the comment and displays it under the post in real-time.
Notifies the post author and other relevant users (e.g., users who also commented) in real-time.

user_journeys.context: An Active Socializer wants to comment on a post.
user_journeys.trigger: User wants to engage in a discussion on a post.

steps.description: Navigates to another user's profile (e.g., by clicking on their username in a post).
Displays the other user's profile with a 'Follow' button.

user_journeys.trigger: User wants to see content from a specific user in their feed.

Displays the user's profile with an 'Following' button.
Clicks the 'Following' button.
Updates the button to 'Follow' and removes the user's content from the Active Socializer's customized timeline in real-time.
Notifies the unfollowed user (if enabled in settings).

user_journeys.context: An Active Socializer no longer wishes to see content from a previously followed user.
user_journeys.trigger: User wants to stop seeing content from a specific user.

steps.description: Navigates to their 'Profile' section.
Displays the user's current profile (bio, avatar, settings options).
Clicks on 'Edit Profile' or a similar option.
Presents editable fields for bio, avatar upload, and access to settings.
Updates their bio, uploads a new avatar, or adjusts privacy/notification settings.

current_prd.navigation_design:
Global Navigation:
  - Mobile: Persistent bottom tab bar with icons for 'Feed', 'Profile', and a central 'Create Post' action button.
  - Desktop: Top navigation bar with links for 'Feed', 'Profile', and a 'Create Post' button.
User Profile Navigation:
  - Within the 'Profile' section, use a tabbed interface or secondary navigation for 'My Profile' (bio, avatar), 'Settings', and potentially 'Followers/Following' lists.
Admin Dashboard Navigation:
  - A dedicated sidebar navigation within the Admin Dashboard for 'Content Moderation', 'User Management', and 'Analytics'.
Login/Signup:
  - Dedicated full-screen flows for 'Login' and 'Signup', separate from the main application navigation.

current_prd.tam_description: Total Addressable Market for the Global Social Media and Online Community Platforms, encompassing all internet users who engage with social media for connection, content sharing, and community building.
current_prd.tam_estimation_basis: Based on the estimated global social media market revenue, considering approximately 5 billion global social media users and an average revenue per user.
current_prd.tam_source: Statista Global Social Media Market Report 2023, eMarketer Social Media Usage Statistics
current_prd.sam_description: Serviceable Available Market for a new social web app targeting Socially Active Individuals (18-35, tech-savvy) and Content Creators/Community Builders, who seek a unified platform for real-time content sharing, personalized feeds, and dynamic community engagement.
current_prd.sam_estimation_basis: Estimated 20 percent of the TAM, representing the segment of social media users and creators who prioritize seamless, personalized, and community-focused online interactions, aligning with the app's core value proposition.
current_prd.sam_source: Demographic analysis of global social media users, user behavior studies on platform preferences.
current_prd.som_description: Serviceable Obtainable Market, representing the realistic market share a new social web app can capture within the SAM over a 5-year horizon, given the highly competitive landscape and the challenges of user acquisition and retention.
current_prd.som_estimation_basis: A conservative 0.5 percent market share estimate of the SAM over 5 years, acknowledging the dominance of established competitors and the significant investment required for market penetration.
current_prd.som_source: Competitive analysis of major social media platforms, historical data on new social network adoption rates and growth.
current_prd.pricing_model_basis: Ad-supported (primary), with potential for future freemium models or creator monetization features.
current_prd.advantage_summary: Unified platform for real-time content sharing, personalized feeds, and dynamic community building, fostering genuine connections and vibrant online communities by solving fragmented online interactions.

class Post < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :user, class_name: 'User'
  belongs_to :organization
  has_many :comments, dependent: :destroy
  has_many :likes, dependent: :destroy
  has_one_attached :image

  validates :content, presence: true

  rhino_owner :organization
  rhino_references [:user, :organization]
end

class Follow < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :follower, class_name: 'User'
  belongs_to :following, class_name: 'User'

  validates :follower_id, uniqueness: { scope: :following_id }
  validate :cannot_follow_self

  def cannot_follow_self
    if follower_id == following_id
      errors.add(:following_id, "cannot follow yourself")
    end
  end

  rhino_owner :follower
  rhino_references [:follower, :following]
end
planned.migration_content:
class CreateFollows < ActiveRecord::Migration[7.2]
  def change
    create_table :follows do |t|
      t.references :follower, null: false, foreign_key: { to_table: :users }
      t.references :following, null: false, foreign_key: { to_table: :users }

      t.timestamps
    end
    add_index :follows, [:follower_id, :following_id], unique: true
    add_check_constraint :follows, 'follower_id != following_id', name: 'cannot_follow_self'
  end
end
